name: Badge
description: A small status or category label. Not a control — if it can be pressed, reach for Button instead.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which signal it carries. `destructive` is reserved for genuine failure, never emphasis.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render onto the child element instead, so a Badge can be a link without nesting one.

root.description: One pill. The radius is full, not a token step — a badge is a different shape from a button on purpose.

gaps.why: One size keeps badges consistent down a list. A badge that needs to be bigger is usually a Button or a heading.
Same token decision as Button — the palette carries one accent and one destructive.
